[Story]
Zhang San walks into the conference room and finds the atmosphere is extremely tense. The company's top leaders are all here, and they just go through a very sensitive topic discussion. To break this deadlock, Zhang San takes a deep breath, then says with a smile, "Dear leaders, do you know why our company's performance is always so good? That is because we have the most professional team and the top technology, of course, and the good luck my handsome face brings!" After hearing this, everyone can't help but laugh.

[Question]
Why does Zhang San say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Zhang San thinks the company's performance really relates to his handsome face.
B. Zhang San wants to take this opportunity to show his confidence and professional ability to the leadership.
C. Zhang San says this because he wants to ease the tense atmosphere in the conference room.
D. Zhang San thinks he is the company's top technical staff.
